securityRules: Validate competitive/economy data server-side when available
Do not grant rating or shop currency from unverified combat summaries
rewardsPhilosophy: Fun first, fair second, monetization third. Cosmetics preferred; progression purchases are speed and convenience, not mandatory power.
soloCombatUpdate: Progression now centers individual divine mastery, one active divine loadouts, Momentum/Divinity unlocks, stances, reactions, executions, relics, and ascension upgrades.
rosterCollectionUpdate: Players build a main deity plus specialist roster. Missions recommend tactical advantages but never require ownership of a specific deity.
onboardingUpdate: Opening sequence awakens one main deity, teaches solo combat, introduces a radically different second deity through trial, then opens faction discovery.

difficultyAndLevelingBalance.directive: Increase difficulty by making enemies smarter and encounter budgets tighter while letting leveling and gear create visible mastery growth.

deityLevelBands.enemyPressure: adds controllers, hunters, and first elite mechanics
resource denial, shield windows, and boss phase counters
multi-layer elites, enemy deities, capped endgame scaling

difficultyAndLevelingBalance.antiPayToWinGuardrail: Gear widens tactical options and progression speed; hard counters, telegraphs, and objective reads still decide difficult missions.

sourceCultureEquipmentRule: Equipment progression uses source relic weapons, source armor bodies, and source resonance cores per faction; gear widens tactical options without breaking counterplay.

combatFirstProgressionDirective.principle: Progression exists to make the player excited to return to deity battle, not to manage spreadsheets.
combatFirstProgressionDirective.upgradePromise: Every shard, gear piece, faction bonus, unlock, and mastery reward must answer: what new combat moment will this create in the next fight?
returnToBattleLoop: Choose one clear upgrade or unlock
antiPatterns: multi-screen stat chores before basic play
upgrades that change only hidden math
reward loops that delay fighting without adding combat expression

economyMigration: Existing Gate Shards, Deity Relics, Ascension Ember, Trial Favor, Raid Tokens, and Signature Alloy are preserved; GOLD, PREMIUM_CURRENCY, ENERGY, and canonical SHARDS are normalized through the unified economy layer.
freeToPlayProgressionGuardrails: async arena matchmaking uses earned visible save state
battle pass grants never required for campaign
